The forecast shows a steady demand of about 53.75 units per day over the next 14 days.  
With that low variability, the model recommends ordering **20 units** at a time so inventory stays near optimum.  
A **safety stock of 34.99 units** is added to protect the required 90 % service level, reflecting the measured demand variation rather than just lead‑time.  
When the inventory level falls to the **reorder point of 586.78 units**, place a new order—this matches the previous analysis that also found a stable trend, confirming the recommendation’s consistency.
